bead.title: test: prove default (knob-unset) claude Execute routes to subprocess end-to-end
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The completeness review of the native-transport work found NO test proving that with FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT UNSET, a full claude Execute routes through the SUBPROCESS runner (not native). TestClaudeTransportSelection (internal/serviceimpl/execute_claude_transport_test.go) only checks the selection helper in isolation, not the end-to-end Execute dispatch path; so the \"default behavior unchanged\" guarantee is unproven at the service level.

ROOT CAUSE: missing service-level assertion; only unit-level selection is covered.

PROPOSED FIX: Add a service-level test that, with the knob unset, drives the claude harness through the production dispatch path (internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go runSubprocess/newClaudeRunner) and asserts the subprocess transport is used — e.g. the constructed Runner has NativeMode=false and the path resolves the claude binary rather than the native provider. Reuse the existing fake-provider/seam patterns already in execute_claude_transport_test.go and service_execute_test.go. This is expected to be TEST-ONLY; if it reveals the default is not subprocess, that is a real bug to fix.

NON-SCOPE: do NOT change the default; do NOT flip transport.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test TestClaudeDefaultTransportSubprocessEndToEnd (internal/serviceimpl/execute_claude_transport_test.go): with FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT unset, the claude dispatch builds a subprocess Runner (NativeMode=false) and does not take the native path.
2. The test fails (guards) if the default is later flipped to native.
3. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/serviceimpl/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
4. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
